about_the_game:
■ How Deep Can You Go? Brave the Endless Depths of the Dungeon!

A mysterious dungeon no one has ever reached the bottom of—its true depth remains unknown.

How many floors does it have? Is there even a limit to how deep it goes...?

You are one of the brave adventurers daring to take on this legendary challenge.

But beware!

This dungeon is no ordinary place—its structure defies human logic, as if it's testing the very limits of your strength and skill.

How deep will you go before the dungeon claims you...?

－－－－ Features That Make This Game So Addictive －－－－

1. Arrows on the Floor Decide Your Fate!

　　Inside the dungeon, you can only move in the direction indicated by the arrows on the floor.

2. Arrow Tiles Shift Dramatically with Every Step!

　　Once you walk across a tile, it disappears—only to be replaced by a new one with a random arrow direction.

　　Will the newly formed path lead you to treasure... or straight into the arms of a monster?

3. Predict the Path by Watching Which Tiles Stay and Disappear!

　　Not all tiles vanish—some remain exactly as they are.

　　Keep an eye on these persistent tiles and learn to anticipate how the layout will evolve.

4. Every Step Counts—Walk as Far as You Can!

　　In this mysterious dungeon, the farther you walk, the more powerful buffs you'll gain in battle.

　　You'll also have a higher chance of finding better gear from treasure chests.

　　In short, the key to conquering the dungeon is simple: keep moving!

5. Master the Strengths of 4 Unique Classes to Go Deeper!

　　You can choose from four distinct classes.

　　Learn each one's unique strengths and use them wisely to reach the deepest layers of the dungeon.

－－ About the Game System －－


  • Tap on a tile and your character will automatically explore the dungeon, following the direction of the arrows.


  • Combat is also automated—just change your gear and let your character do the rest.


  • You can freely equip gear across six armor slots (7 types), three weapon slots (8 types), and six accessory slots (5 types).
    　*Note: Some gear may be unusable or perform below potential depending on your character’s stats.


  • Find duplicate equipment? Fuse them to power up—just be sure you have enough gold!


  • There are five types of consumable items—use them to restore HP, clear monsters from a floor, change arrow directions, and more to aid your exploration.


  • For every certain number of steps taken, you’ll gain benefits unique to your character’s class.
    　*For example, recovering HP.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: x86 or x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card compatible with DirectX 10
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 120 MB available space

short_description: In this shifting dungeon, you may only move along arrow directions. Tiles vanish once stepped on, and the layout reshuffles! The farther you walk, the greater the combat buffs and treasure loot. Plan your path carefully and keep going deeper—how far can you descend into the abyss?
supported_languages: Japanese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil
